races.paceDynamic: The First Turn sits as the lone confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead in this maiden hurdle field. With Dunleer Crystal and The First Turn likely to set a steady gallop, the pace will be manageable rather than searching, creating conditions where horses can finish from off the pace. The lack of genuine early pace pressure means hold-up horses like Ifallgoeswell, All Night Revival and De Jour En Jour can conserve energy for sustained late runs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can time their challenges perfectly against an honest but not punishing early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The First Turn sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays honest throughout
scenarios.body: The measured gallop allows patient rides to build sustained challenges from the back, with finishing kicks proving decisive over tiring leaders. Hold-up specialists with tactical speed can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dunleer Crystal or another prominent runner gets the perfect trip tracking the leader
scenarios.body: Elliott's charge can utilise Jack Kennedy's tactical nous to position ideally behind The First Turn before striking at the right moment. The prominent position provides the perfect launching pad without doing too much early work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The First Turn's class advantage tells and the gallop stays within comfortable limits
scenarios.body: Curling's five-year-old can dictate throughout and kick clear when the pressure comes, using superior ability to maintain the advantage to the line. Previous course winner credentials become crucial in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden surprise emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced newcomers Great Entirely or Poet's Duke show significant improvement
scenarios.body: Hidden ability surfaces from horses making their hurdles debuts or returning from long breaks, catching the exposed runners off guard. Unexposed potential trumps proven form in a weak maiden contest.

races.paceDynamic: Green Angel is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the start, likely facing minimal early pressure in this 17-runner maiden field. With most runners preferring hold-up tactics, Green Angel can control the tempo and potentially steal a march if allowed an easy lead over the 2m4f trip. The lack of pace pressure should create a tactical affair with plenty of horses held up for late runs, but this could play into the hands of those who can track the pace or get prominent positions early. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners and the lone leader, as hold-up horses may find themselves with too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Green Angel Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Green Angel gets an uncontested lead and maintains sustainable fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter can dictate terms without pressure and prove hard to peg back over this stamina-testing distance. Hold-up horses will struggle to close the gap having given the leader too much rope.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunches up the field for a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to get closer than ideal, setting up a sprint finish that favors those with tactical speed. Quality will rise to the top in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If a prominent runner can track Green Angel without over-racing and strike at the right moment
scenarios.body: Positioning just off the leader provides the perfect stalking trip, avoiding the early pace battle while staying close enough to pounce. This tactical approach often proves optimal in maidens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Green Angel stops quickly after setting the pace and the race falls apart tactically
scenarios.body: The leader's effort tells late and creates a messy finish where stamina and class become decisive factors. Horses finishing strongest from midfield can capitalize on the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Ceroc and Hitthehayson will contest the early pace, with Ceroc's recent front-running style clashing against Hitthehayson's three wins from the front this season. Noble Talent, Accustomed, and Bocelli's Voice will track prominently behind the leaders, creating a solid gallop over the 2m4f trip. The large field of 17 runners includes numerous hold-up horses like Cowper Hall, Miss Mini Bee, and Teenage Kiss who will rely on staying power. This honest pace favours prominent runners and patient hold-up horses with proven stamina, disadvantaging those needing to make their move early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Ceroc and Hitthehayson maintain a genuine gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace will set up perfectly for hold-up horses with stamina to finish strongly in the final furlong. Cowper Hall's class and Teenage Kiss's recent form make them prime beneficiaries of this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and tie up
scenarios.body: Prominent runners like Noble Talent and Accustomed will inherit the lead as Ceroc and Hitthehayson fade. Their tactical positioning allows them to capitalize without overexerting early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hitthehayson Dominates Again
scenarios.trigger: If Hitthehayson can dictate fractions from the front
scenarios.body: His three wins this season show he excels when controlling the tempo, and the 5lb claimer reduces his burden. Ceroc's inconsistency suggests he may not sustain the challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go steady and kill the gallop
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race would favour horses with a turn of foot rather than stamina. Miss Mini Bee's topspeed of 105 and Accustomed's 109 rating give them tactical speed.

races.paceDynamic: Supreme Jet will lead from the outset with no genuine pace pressure early, setting a controlled gallop that suits his style. scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Butty O Brien stays on
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his gallop and the field comes too late
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old's stamina reserves prove superior on this testing ground and he holds off all challengers. His recent third at similar conditions gives him the edge when others tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos helps outsider
scenarios.trigger: If there are multiple fallers or the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than ability, allowing a horse like Baltinglass Hill or Oogum Boogum to capitalize. The disrupted rhythm suits those who can adapt quickly.
